title: Great Dehumidifier for the money. Silent and efficient
text: Great Dehumidifier for the money. Silent and efficient. As one of the other reviewers stated, I also live in Southern Florida. The humidity down here can be downright unbearable at times (I am a replanted NJ woman). My central air conditioner runs constantly not only because of the heat but the humidity (there is a sensor on it which recognizes the 'feels like' temperature (not just the actual temperature). I have been using this Whynter for over a week now and I have noticeably heard my air conditioning unit kicking on less and less. I know I am saving electricity by using this dehumidifier and, on top of it all, this unit is Energy Star compliant which just seals the deal even more.  I also feel I am breathing better at night (allergies are far less bothersome). This is easy to set up and runs almost silently. If you are in the market for a dehumidifier, you can't do better than this unit. It does the job and ultimately will save you money.

product_metadata.title: Whynter 40 Pint Portable Dehumidifier, Multi
features: Adjustable humidity range of 35 - 85% relative humidity
Runs quiet with normal operating noise level below 50 dBA
description: Maintain a comfortable humidity level in your home or office with the Whynter 40 Pint Portable Dehumidifier. The Whynter RPD-411WG has the capability of removing up to 40 pints of moisture from the air over a 24 hour period. The compact Whynter RPD-411WG is specifically devised for small spaces while retaining an emphasis on designer styling for the most discerning users. Features include a water indicator alert with automatic shut-off which lets you know when the 10 pint tank is full, auto-restart feature which saves your settings during a power outage and auto-defrosting capability to prevent frost build-up. It also features a continuous draining option available with a drain hose. This portable dehumidifier offers a removable, easy to clean 2-in-1 silver-coated washable pre-filter, heavy duty caster wheels and sturdy concealed handle allow for this portable dehumidifier to be easily moved from room to room. Built for large capacity usage, this unit is suited for use in enclosed areas up to 2500 sq. ft. Features: 40 pint (18.9 liter) capacity dehumidifier; 10 pint (4.73 liter) removable water bucket; Auto-restart and Auto-shutoff functions; Adjustable humidity range of 35 - 85% relative humidity; Low temperature operation (minimum ambient temperature low 40 Degrees); Auto-defrosting capability to prevent frost build-up inside unit; Electronic controls with humidity sensor settings; Direct drain option for continuous operation; Runs quiet with normal operating noise level below 50 dBA; Dual fan speeds and 24 timer function; 2 in 1 silver-coated washable pre-filter combo included; Handles and caster wheels for portability; Non ozone-depleting refrigerant: R410a; 20" drain hose included for gravity drainage; Air Flow (at high speed): 180 m3/h/105CFM; Power Supply: 115 V/60 Hz; Unit Dimensions: 15.25"W x 9.25"D x 22.25"H (19.5" in H when casters are not installed); UL listed.
